definitions.full: H3241. Yanim or Yanum יָנוּם proper name, of a location city in Judah , Josh 15:53 Qr; Kt ינים (so van d. H. Ginsb; Baer only יָנוּם ); ᵐ5 Ιεμαειν , A ᵐ5 L Ιανουμ .
